title: The remaining Jews gather at Gedaliah in Mizpah
description: When the commanders who were in the fields heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah over the land, they came to him at Mizpah—among them Ishmael, Johanan and Jonathan. Gedaliah swore to them not to fear serving the Chaldeans, but to stay in the land, gather wine, summer fruit and oil, and serve the king of Babylon, so that things would go well for them. Also, Jews who had been scattered in Moab, among the Ammonites and in Edom returned to Judah and gathered large amounts of wine and summer fruit.
